notes: Fixed: a written label (like "4002-2") was taken for the reference line. The app now looks for a narrow line that runs along the sample, and finds the mark again on your existing scans (marks you set by hand are kept). The mark is 0°: the 3D view turns to it and the dial reads 0° there
Every picture of the sample sheet opens full screen on its own: the sheets, each view, the top, the bottom and the unrolled side. Pinch to zoom, swipe to the next, share or save each one
The bottom view is left out when the rock wasn't flipped and its underside scanned
